verdict.rationale: Milvus is open-source and self-deployable: as Lite on a laptop, Standalone on Docker, or Distributed on Kubernetes, and Lite stores all data in a user-specified local file. This lets users decide where their data physically resides, but nothing documents region selection or residency controls as such. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection documentation (e.g., managed-service region choice), residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration of data-location control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: To create a local Milvus vector database, simply instantiate a `MilvusClient` by specifying a file name to store all data
you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster
Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.
